findings.title: OS Command Injection in SiteSaver URL Validation
findings.description: The SiteSaver application is vulnerable to OS command injection via the `url` parameter on the `/add_url` endpoint. The `check_url()` function in `app.py` constructs a shell command using f-string interpolation with user-supplied input and passes it to `os.popen()`, allowing arbitrary command execution. The vulnerability was exploited to extract the flag from the container's environment.

reproduction.expected: Command injection executes cat flag.txt on the server
